# Boubacar Barry

> Boubacar Barry is an AI strategy consultant who helps owner-operators and leadership teams at growing businesses cut through the AI noise, find their real constraint, and build systems around it. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah. Also builds and shares free tools and practical AI systems in public.

## What Boubacar does

- [Home / current work](https://boubacarbarry.com/): AI strategy consulting for owner-operators and leadership teams at growing businesses. Focus is naming the real constraint before recommending any tool or system.
- [Tools & Projects](https://boubacarbarry.com/tools): AI tools and projects built by Boubacar -- practical systems for automation, productivity, and operational efficiency.
- [Catalyst Toolbox](https://boubacarbarry.com/toolbox/): Free productivity tools -- a character counter, a YouTube transcript extractor, and a file converter -- built for consultants, leaders, and owner-operators.

## Who it is for

- Owner-operators and leadership teams at growing businesses who suspect AI could help but are not sure where to start or what to trust.
- Consultants, leaders, and operators looking for free, practical tools rather than another AI pitch.
